notice: Sending is optional. Your question or experience goes to Lift’s private review storage. It is not published to the community board. A response is not guaranteed.
adult: I am 18 or older and am sending my own question or experience.
consent: I agree to send this text for private review. I have removed names, contact details, document numbers, exact addresses and identifying details about other people.
ai: Optional: allow an editor to share a redacted version with ZCode for AI-assisted review.
aiHelp: You can leave this unchecked. AI suggestions are a first pass and do not count as qualified legal or health review.
retention: Receipt access ends after 14 days. Scheduled cleanup removes expired records. Withdrawal removes the question text from the current record; provider backups and copies already shared are outside this page’s controls.
receiptWarning: Keep your receipt code private. Anyone with it can check a reply or withdraw this submission. There is no account recovery if you lose it.
received: Received for private review. This does not mean it has been checked, answered or published.
receiptMemory: Your receipt is not saved automatically, even when plan saving is on. Copy or download it before leaving. Copies remain outside Lift.
waiting: Received. No approved reply is available yet.
answered: An approved private reply is available.
withdrawExplain: This removes the question text from the current private record and prevents normal retries from restoring it. It does not delete any separate public post or copies already shared.
notFound: No submission was found for this code. Check the code and try again.
closed: Private submissions are not open yet. You can still prepare, copy or share a draft yourself.
unavailable: The request could not be confirmed. Keep your receipt code and check status before sending again.
rateLimited: Too many requests from this connection. Please try again later.
consentNeeded: Confirm the two required choices before sending. AI review is optional.
offline: Private submissions and replies need internet access. Your draft tools can still be used offline.
noUrgent: This service is not continuously monitored. Use a support service directly for urgent assistance.
